item.title: O' Romeo Advance Booking: Shahid Kapoor and Triptii Dimri's romantic action film sells 10,000 tickets in National Chains for Day 1
item.description: O' Romeo, starring Shahid Kapoor and Triptii Dimri in the lead roles, is all set to hit the big screens this weekend. The movie has opened its advances yesterday, three days prior to the release. So far, the advance booking looks pretty decent and in the range of Shahid Kapoor's last two releases, Teri Baaton Mein Uljha Jiya and Devaa. As of Wednesday (Feb 12, 2026), the romantic action drama sold around 10,000 tickets in the top two national chains, PVR Inox and Cinepolis, for the opening day.
